blockers.title: B3: the N4 restructure removed the post-trigger guard — a successful (a)/(b) trigger no longer gates the (c) pool backstop, so ONE (archetype, set_piece) activation can emit two Crisis_Triggered events and hold two active rows on the same tick (E13 dedup breach)
blockers.location: core/crisis.odin:430-483 (trigger pass) — regression vs f906725's post-trigger `continue`
blockers.evidence: r2 (f906725): 'crisis_trigger(state, tick, cat, ai, u16(si), .Saturated_Bundle, b, sp.class, sp.multiplier)\n\t\t\tcontinue' — the continue skipped (c) after a successful (a)/(b) trigger. r3 (121d8a0): (a) fires -> a_hit = true -> (b) skipped via !a_hit -> (c) checks only crisis_cooldown_blocked(.Pool_Exhaustion, 0, 0) (a DIFFERENT kind — never blocks a Saturated_Bundle trigger) -> crisis_trigger appends a SECOND row. crisis_trigger appends unconditionally (no crisis_active_for check); the dedup check runs once at the top of the set-piece loop, BEFORE any trigger. Probe (pool cap 14, email BE + streaming standard, narrow host->rt, seed 3003) tick=1200: triggers=2, active_rows=2 — kind=1 Saturated_Bundle bundle=2 AND kind=2 Pool_Exhaustion bundle=NO_BUNDLE, both set_piece=0 archetype=0. Reproduces at caps 11-14 (legal catalog values; the parser requires only pool_max_packets > 0).
blockers.detail: Two Crisis_Triggered events with no resolve between = the E13 duplicate the lens-guards define as a blocker; the frozen letter says 'Crisis_State.active holds at most one crisis per (archetype, set-piece activation)'. Two rows double the banner cards and the serialized section for one activation. Impossible at f906725 — a regression introduced by the N4 restructure.
blockers.recommended_fix: After a SUCCESSFUL crisis_trigger in (a) or (b), `continue` to the next set-piece (or re-check crisis_active_for before (c)). N4's intent survives: only a successful trigger gates the pool backstop — a cooldown-BLOCKED (a) still falls through to (c).

warnings.title: W-poolcap: with pool_max_packets = 1 or 2 (legal catalog values) a Pool_Exhaustion crisis triggers but can NEVER resolve — a permanent crisis (fairness rule 4: the player can always recover)
warnings.evidence: resolve: 'cleared = len(state.flow.packets) + int(CRISIS_RESOLVE_MARGIN) < int(cat.balance.pool_max_packets) && !drop_of_reason_this_tick(...)'. CRISIS_RESOLVE_MARGIN = 2. cap 1: len + 2 < 1 impossible; cap 2: len + 2 < 2 impossible. Trigger side fires fine ('drop && len + 2 >= cap' is always true with a drop). The E9 path has the N5 margin clamp ('if bound > 0 && bound <= margin { margin = bound - 1 }') — the pool cap has no equivalent. Shipped balance.json = 512 (unreachable in shipped content) — catalog-authoring-only, so warning not blocker.
warnings.detail: A cap-1/2 catalog (legal per the parser's own validation) produces a crisis that never clears even after the player fixes the network — the anti-flap margin eats the entire recovery band.
warnings.recommended_fix: Clamp the resolve margin for the pool cap (e.g. margin = min(margin, cap-1), the N5 pattern) or validate pool_max_packets >= 3 at load.
